name: Accept and dismiss a finding; the state survives a reload
description: Needs the mock LLM (skipped otherwise) and runs after 09: acts on the two findings of the mock review 09 created, which is the newest run so its accordion is open by default. The first finding of the open run is expanded by default → Accept → 'accepted' tag; expand the other → Dismiss → 'dismissed' tag; reload and both tags come back from the server (POST /findings/:id/accept|dismiss persisted accepted_at / dismissed_at, not just the optimistic cache). WRITES — the hermetic stack reseeds every run. Starts with a 2000px-tall viewport (kept for later flows): the PR page scrolls inside <main>, and agent-browser neither scrolls that container on click nor with scrollintoview/scroll, so a below-the-fold Accept click silently hits nothing.
